name: dog_kennels
description: The dog_kennels database stores information about breeds (breed code, breed name), charges (charge size, charge amount), sizes (size code, size description, treatment types (treatment type code, treatment type description), owners (first name, last name, street, city, state, zip code, email address, home phone, cell number), dogs (owner id, abandoned yes or no, breed code, size code, name, age, date of birth, gender, weight, date arrived, date adopted, date departed), professionals (role code, first name, street, city, state, zip code, last name, email address, home phone, cell number), and treatments (dog id, professional id, treatment type code, date of treatment, cost of treatment).

name: flight_2
description: The flight_2 database stores information about airlines (airline name, abbreviation, country), airports (city, airport code, airport name, country, country abbrev), and flights (airline, flight number, source airport, destination airport).

name: pets_1
description: The pets_1 database contains information about students (last name, first name, age, sex, major, advisor, city code), their pets (pet type, pet age, weight), and the relationships in has pet (student id, pet id).

name: concert_singer
description: The concert_singer database contains information about stadiums (location, name, capacity, highest, lowest, average), singers (name, country, song name, song release year, age, is male), concerts (concert name, theme, stadium id, year), and which singers perform in each concert (singer id).

name: museum_visit
description: The museum_visit database stores information about museums (name, num of staff, open year), customers (name, level of membership, age), and their visits (museum id, customer id, num of ticket, total spent).

name: battle_death
description: The battle_death database contains information about battles (name, date, bulgarian commander, latin commander, result), ships (lost in battle, id, name, tonnage, ship type, location, disposition of ship), and deaths (caused by ship id, id, note, killed, injured).

name: student_transcripts_tracking
description: The student_transcripts_tracking database stores information about addresses (line 1, line 2, line 3, city, zip postcode, state province county, country, other address details), courses (course name, course description, other details), departments (department name, department description, other details), degree programs (department id, degree summary name, degree summary description, other details), sections (course id, section name, section description, other details), semesters (semester name, semester description, other details), students (current address id, permanent address id, first name, middle name, last name, cell mobile number, email address, date first registered, date left, other student details), student enrolment (degree program id, semester id, student id, other details), student enrolment courses, transcripts (transcript date, other details), and transcript contents (student course id, transcript id).

name: singer
description: The singer database contains information about singers (name, birth year, net worth millions, citizenship) and their songs (title, singer id, sales, highest position).

name: cre_Doc_Template_Mgt
description: The cre_Doc_Template_Mgt database stores information about reference template types (template type code, template type description), templates (version number, template type code, date effective from, date effective to, template details), documents (template id, document name, document description, other details), and paragraphs (document id, paragraph text, other details).

name: world_1
description: The world_1 database contains information about cities (name, country code, district, population), countries (code, name, continent, region, surface area, indepdent year, population, life expectancy, gnp, gnp old, local name, government form, head of state, capital, code2), country languages (countrycode, language, is official, percentage), and SQLite sequences (name, seq).

name: employee_hire_evaluation
description: The employee_hire_evaluation database stores information about employees (name, age, city), shops (name, location, district, number products, manager name), hiring records (employee id, start from, is full time), and evaluations (employee id, year awarded, bonus).

name: network_1
description: The network_1 database contains information about high schoolers (name, grade), their friends (student id, friend id), and the things they like (student id, liked id).

name: poker_player
description: The poker_player database stores information about poker players (people id, final table made, best finish, money rank, earnings) and people (nationality, name, birth date, height).

name: real_estate_properties
description: The real_estate_properties database contains information about reference feature types (feature type code, feature type name), reference property types (property type code, property type description), other available features (feature type code, feature name, feature description), properties (property type code, date on market, date sold, property name, property address, room count, vendor requested price, buyer offered price, agreed selling price, apt feature, fld feature, hse feature, oth feature, shp feature, other property details), and other property features (property id, property feature description).

name: course_teach
description: The course_teach database stores information about courses (staring date, course), teachers (name, age, hometown), and course arrangements (teacher id, grade).

name: voter_1
description: The voter_1 database contains information about area code states (area code, state), contestants (contestant number, contestant name), and votes (phone number, state, contestant number, created).

name: wta_1
description: The wta_1 database stores information about players (first name, last name, hand, birth date, country code), matches (best of, draw size, loser age, loser entry, loser hand, loser ht, loser id, loser ioc, loser name, loser rank, loser rank points, loser seed, match num, minutes, round, score, surface, tourney date, tourney id, tourney level, tourney name, winner age, winner entry, winner hand, winner ht, winner id, winner ioc, winner name, winner rank, winner rank points, winner seed, year), and rankings (ranking date, ranking, player id, ranking points, tours).

name: orchestra
description: The orchestra database contains information about conductors (name, age, nationality, year of work), orchestras (orchestra, conductor id, record company, year of founded, major record format), performances (orchestra id, type, date, official ratings (millions), weekly rank, share), and shows (performance id, if first show, result, attendance).

name: car_1
description: The car_1 database stores information about continents, countries (country name, continent), car makers (maker, full name, country), model lists (maker, model), car names (make id, model, make), and car data (mpg, cylinders, edispl, horsepower, weight, accelerate, year).

name: tvshow
description: The tvshow database contains information about TV channels (series name, country, language, content, pixel aspect ratio par, hight definition tv, pay per view ppv, package option), TV series (episode, air date, rating, share, 18 49 rating share, viewers m, weekly rank, channel), and cartoons (title, directed by, written by, original air date, production code, channel).
